title: Scaling Causal Reasoning with Increasingly Complex Causal Simulators
abstract: arXiv:2605.09079v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Despite surpassing human performance across mathematics, coding, and other knowledge-intensive tasks, large language models (LLMs) continue to struggle with causal reasoning. A core obstacle is the target data itself: causal systems are complex and often expressed in non-executable forms, while ground-truth answers to causal queries are inherently scarce. We introduce CauSim, a framework that turns causal reasoning from a scarce-label problem into a scalable supervised one. CauSim constructs increasingly complex causal simulators: executable structural causal models (SCMs), incrementally built by LLMs, that scale to globally complex systems while maintaining verifiable answers to causal queries. CauSim operates across representations by formalizing non-executable causal knowledge into code, enabling data augmentation, and translating executable SCMs into natural language, enabling supervision in previously difficult-to-supervise repr

translated_title: 通过日益复杂的因果模拟器扩展因果推理
translated_abstract: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）在数学、编程和其他知识密集型任务上已经超越人类表现，但在因果推理方面仍然表现不佳。一个核心障碍在于目标数据本身：因果系统复杂且通常以不可执行的形式表达，而因果查询的真实答案本质上稀缺。我们提出了 CauSim，一个将因果推理从稀缺标签问题转变为可扩展监督问题的框架。CauSim 构建日益复杂的因果模拟器：由 LLM 增量构建的可执行结构因果模型（SCM），这些模型可扩展至全局复杂系统，同时保持对因果查询的可验证答案。CauSim 可跨表示形式运作：通过将不可执行的因果知识形式化为代码来实现数据增强，并将可执行的 SCM 转换为自然语言，从而在以前难以监督的表示形式中实现监督。
tldr: 提出 CauSim 框架，利用 LLM 增量构建可验证的日益复杂的因果模拟器（可执行 SCM），将因果推理从稀缺标签问题转化为可扩展的监督学习问题。
en_tdlr: CauSim transforms causal reasoning from a scarce-label problem into a scalable supervised one by using LLMs to incrementally build increasingly complex, verifiable causal simulators in the form of executable SCMs.
